# BREAKING: Hitler Speech Played at UN Meeting, TIC Accuses Hawaza of Neo-Nazism and Sexual Harassment, Threatens War on Build and Conquer Community

A Hitler speech was played during today's UN meeting. It is not yet known who played it.

Following the meeting, The Inner Circle (TIC) said it will declare war on anybody within the Build and Conquer community.

TIC has also accused members of Hawaza of sexually harassing players in direct messages and of holding neo-Nazi views, and has criticized Slop Company's moderation team for failing to act. TIC has provided evidence of the neo-nazism allegations, the sexual harassment is still not backed by evidence yet. BCBN is investigating these accusations made by TIC.

Hawaza and Slop Company have not yet responded.

More information will come in the following days.

**Journalists:** @revnova.
